steps.text: Bill created or synced from an ERP
Paid by PSID, QR or Request to Pay

_sources.source: Evamp & Saanga's product page, https://evampsaanga.com/asaan-bill/ (tagline "Digital Payments Simplified")
_sources.flow: Create an invoice → it reaches the customer by email or mobile → payment in real time via 1LINK (1-LINK Bill Payment in banking apps, and Raast P2M) → track and reconcile. Invoices can also sync from an ERP or CRM.
_sources.rajasPart: cv.json: 0→1 launch on the 1Bill aggregator approval, Raast P2M go-to-market, 15+ ERP partnerships opening the restaurant vertical. Payment types: PSID, QR and Request to Pay.

The four steps (Phase 16, from TapitCard's own "How it works" copy) time the card's beats; they are no longer shown as text.

steps.text: Share it with a tap or QR

_sources.source: https://thetapitcard.com/ (tagline "Revolutionizing networking and contact sharing with JUST A TAP!")
_sources.product: A tap opens a profile with social links, WhatsApp and "Save vCard", plus services with an enquiry button. The Enterprise plan covers 5 vCards.
_sources.rajasPart: cv.json: pre-sold the prototype, grew to 3,000+ customers mostly through B2B sales to corporates, led growth, brand and the sales funnel. The technology was led by Haziq Farooq (CTO).
_sources.howItWorks: thetapitcard.com "How it works?": "Create, Login, Add up your Social Links and Start NETWORKING!" and "Register a new account, create your own digital business card, Add up your details and start sharing your contact with a TAP or QR."

_sources.rajasWords: An online thrift store started during COVID. People wanted branded clothes at a good price, but hygiene and convenience held them back, and "we bridge that". Sold through hostel dorms. PKR 1 Cr in sales.
